  • Habitat conservation is the protection, management, and restoration of natural
  • environments to ensure that plant and animal species can survive, reproduce, and
  • maintain healthy populations. It focuses on preserving the ecological conditions and
  • resources, necessary for the long-term sustainability of biodiversity.

questions.question: Describe the setup of a longline culture system. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the setup of a longline culture system.
  • A longline culture system is a type of open-water mariculture setup used mainly for
  • mussels, oysters and seaweeds. It consists of a horizontal main line floating on the
  • water surface and anchored securely at both ends.
  • Setup of a Longline Culture System : Main Rope/Longline, Floats/Buoys, Anchors
  • and Mooring System, Culture Units
  • Site Requirements:Clean, well-flushed water with moderate currents.
  • Adequate depth to keep droppers from touching the bottom.
  • Function: The longline floats on the surface while the culture organisms grow on
  • vertical ropes below, benefiting from natural food and good water circulation.

questions.question: Write a short note on fixed cost in aquaculture. / [CO5] [3x5 = 15]
questions.solution_html:
• Write a short note on fixed cost in aquaculture
  • Fixed cost in aquaculture refers to the portion of production cost that does not change
  • with the level of output. These expenses remain constant whether the farm produces a
  • small amount of fish or operates at full capacity.
  • Incurred regardless of production volume
  • Repeated at regular intervals
  • Essential for maintaining farm infrastructure
  • Examples: Land lease or pond rent, Depreciation of ponds, tanks, cages, and
  • equipment, Salaries of permanent staff, Interest on capital investment, administrative
  • expenses
  • Importance
  • Fixed costs help determine the break-even point, guide financial planning, and assess
  • the overall profitability of an aquaculture enterprise.
